subject: Request: assign missing procurement serials & reconcile line items
messages:
From: Anita Rao <procure@skyline.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missing serials / spend caps on onboarding batch

Hi Mateo,

We're wrapping up our vendor onboarding for the August batch and ran into a blocking item: several provisional purchase serials you issued don't have the final PO numbers mapped and a handful of line items are missing spend-cap assignments. Our AP team can't finalize the payment terms without the canonical PO numbers and associated spend caps.

Summary of what we found:
- 3 provisional serials (S-20260815-01/02/04) lack firm PO numbers.
- Multiple line items were combined in the provisioning file but need to be split to match our ledger (SKU-level).
- We don't have the spend cap per vendor for period Sep-Nov; AP requires the cap to complete vendor setup.

I've attached the completed onboarding form and a short CSV with the SkyLine IDs and the ledger lines we expect. Can you confirm who owns the PO assignment and when we can expect the canonical POs? If it's easier, can we get temporary hard-limited POs for the first month while you reconcile the line splits?

Appreciate a quick ETA — we have a go-live target of Sep 7.

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Procurement Lead
Skyline Logistics
[Attachment: skyline_onboard_form.pdf]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <procure@skyline.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing serials / spend caps on onboarding batch

Hi Anita — thanks for the note and the attachments. Apologies for the gap, we should have caught the missing PO mapping earlier.

Quick plan of action from our side:
1) Ben will own the canonical PO assignment and create permanent PO numbers for the three provisional serials.
2) Monica and I will reconcile the ledger lines against your CSV and produce a suggested line-split mapping (SKU-level) by EOD Monday (Aug 31).
3) We can provision temporary limited POs (single-use hard cap) for Sep 1–30 if you need an immediate stopgap — those will be tagged with the "TEMP-" prefix.

Ben / Monica / Grace — can you confirm capacity to action the PO creation and the ledger reconciliation? Ben, I'll loop you into the staging ledger access; you'll see the provisional serials under the "onboard-aug-2026" bucket.

Anita — posting a link to the ticket for transparency: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4123. I'll update it as items move.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Anita Rao <procure@skyline.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 14:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing serials / spend caps on onboarding batch

On Sat, Aug 29, 2026 at 11:03 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben / Monica / Grace — can you confirm capacity to action the PO creation and the ledger reconciliation?

I can take PO assignment — I'll generate canonical POs and the temporary caps if needed. Next steps from me:
- Create permanent PO numbers for S-20260815-01/02/04 (expected by Mon, Aug 31 17:00 PDT).
- Seed temporary PO IDs with a hard cap for Sep (TEMP-SKY-202609) and provide the expiration and cap metadata to Skyline AP.
- Attachments: uploading ledger_claims.csv with suggested line splits and a small notes sheet.

Notes / questions for Monica: I flagged two SKUs that appear to be aggregated in your CSV (lines 4 and 7). Do we have the unit pricing that Skyline wants split across the new sub-lines, or should we use the provisioning price and mark for follow-up with finance?

I'll push the PO numbers to PROC-4123 and send the signed matrix to Anita once the POs are generated.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ledger_claims.csv]

From: Anita Rao <procure@skyline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing serials / spend caps on onboarding batch

Thanks Ben — that's great and aligns with our timeline. A few clarifying points before you finalize the PO matrix: 
- For the two aggregated SKUs, please use the provisioning price for now and flag the lines for an AP reconciliation job next billing cycle.
- Please include the spend cap metadata in the PO notes field (cap amount, effective dates, and any per-line limits). Our system ingests those notes for automated payment holds.

If you can push the TEMP POs today, we can complete setup and begin limited provisioning on Sep 1. Otherwise, an ETA by EOD Mon is acceptable.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Anita
Procurement Lead
Skyline Logistics
notes: Thread keeps procurement, finance, and onboarding stakeholders looped; action items assigned to Ben and Monica; temporary POs proposed as stopgap; related ticket PROC-4123 created and linked.
